scope: Actual HTTP and abrupt isolated server-process exit with disposable synthetic accounts and SQLite stores.
retry_timing: Eligibility controlled in disposable storage; no elapsed backoff or RTO measurement.
limitations: One injected pre-commit process stop; not power-loss, storage-device failure, secure remote transport, general exactly-once or physical acceptance evidence.
sanitization: Allowlisted assertions and aggregate counts only; no identities, credentials, sessions, record IDs, URLs, database files or local paths.
